name: 抑郁自评量表
instructions: 请根据您最近一周的实际情况，选择最符合的一项。
instructionsEn: Based on your actual situation over the past week, choose the option that fits you best.
license: Zung 编制，可免费使用，使用时请注明出处。

options.label: 偶或无
options.labelEn: None or a little of the time

items.textEn: I feel down-hearted and blue.
I feel best in the morning.
I have crying spells or feel like crying.
I have trouble sleeping at night.
I eat as much as I used to.
My sexual function is normal.
I feel that I am losing weight.
I am bothered by constipation.
My heart beats faster than usual.
I get tired for no reason.

items.text: 我的头脑像往常一样清楚
items.textEn: My mind is as clear as it used to be.

items.text: 我做事情像平时一样不感到困难
items.textEn: I find it as easy to do things as I always did.

items.text: 我坐卧不安，难以保持平静
items.textEn: I feel restless and cannot keep still.
I feel hopeful about the future.
I am more irritable than usual.

items.text: 我觉得决定什么事很容易
items.textEn: I find it easy to make decisions.

items.text: 我感到自己是有用的和不可缺少的人
items.textEn: I feel that I am useful and indispensable.
I feel that my life is meaningful.

items.text: 假若我死了别人会过得更好
items.textEn: I would be better off if I were dead.

items.text: 我仍旧喜爱自己平时喜爱的东西
items.textEn: I still enjoy the things I used to enjoy.

totalBands.description: 标准分低于50分，未提示明显抑郁症状。
标准分50-59分，提示轻度抑郁。
标准分60-69分，提示中度抑郁。
标准分70分及以上，提示重度抑郁。

crisis.message: 您在第19题（假若我死了别人会过得更好）上回答为“经常”或“持续”。如果您正处于危机之中或感到不安全，请立即联系当地急救电话或心理援助热线，或告诉身边可信任的人。
